about: Camera spots for the walkable Rainbow Bridge (S3, u 15500-20500), in the one world frame (metres: X east, D north, H height; facing_deg 0 = +X east, 90 = north). Everything placed in the world comes from the scroll map through layout.json (tools/map_layout.mjs); this file only says where the camera can stand.

seam.about: just east of the S4b seam (u 15500) on the south bank's road, looking east along the river past 十千脚店's riverside hall

tavern_gate.about: the forecourt of 十千脚店: the gate under the 彩楼欢门 scaffold, the lamp-box sign, the 杈子 barrier

open_ground.about: the open ground east of the tavern: the 串车 set down, the 新酒 pole and banner, the stalls under the mat canopy, the boat unloading at the bank

south_foot.about: the crowd at the bridge's south foot, the parasol stalls, the south ramp going up

crown.about: on the deck at the crown, looking back down the south ramp over the crowd

rail.about: at the near (east) railing at the crown, looking down at the big boat lowering its mast (上下呼救)

north_foot.about: on the bridge's north ramp near its foot, looking along the north bank toward the tavern at the water's edge and the handcart

under_arch.about: the south bank under the arch: the mat sheds, the big parasol, the waving men on the moored boat

from_bank.about: the bridge from the south bank: the arch, the big boat under it

far_bank.about: from the south bank across the west reach: the far bank's shops and eating places, its moored boats

east_seam.about: in front of the open shop near the S2 seam, looking back west to the bridge
